If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his…
Your eyes shall not pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.
‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you don’t see? Why have we afflicted our soul, and you don’t notice?’ “Behold, in…
Behold, you fast for strife and contention, and to strike with the fist of wickedness. You don’t fast today so as to…
Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.
“ ‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not…
Yahweh said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” Yahweh appointed a sign…
If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times.”
The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death.
for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword…

translations.web: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, the man shall surely be punished.
translations.bsb: If a man strikes his manservant or maidservant with a rod, and the servant dies by his hand, he shall surely be punished.
translations.kjv: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.
translations.asv: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall surely be punished.
